items.title: Pay invoice for dog training course
items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). The period 'nach Rechnungsdatum' is a period of time, not a calendar date, so it is computed under §§ 187, 188 BGB: since the invoice date is the triggering event, the day itself (21.11.2026) is not counted and the 14-day period begins the next day, 22.11.2026 (§187 Abs.1 BGB). A period of 14 days starting 22.11 ends, inclusive, on the 14th day counted from 22.11, which is 05.12.2026 (§188 Abs.1 BGB). 05.12.2026 is a Saturday. Under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period for performing an obligation falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. 06.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday, 07.12.2026. No NW public holiday falls in this window.
